items.docs:
[operation: workspace-list]



READ-ONLY



Lists the workspaces that partition the org and yields the workspaceId most other calls need to scope their work. Hierarchy: Tenant → Workspaces → Teams → Users. Paginated (default pageSize 200).

→

    [{workspaceId, name, settings}]

see: workspace-list-users (members), workspace-add/remove-users (manage membership), meeting-list/export (filter by workspaceId), concierge-logs (filter by workspaceId)

info.name: Read all users (or in a workspace)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. First page has index 0.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page. Maximum is 50

items.docs:
[operation: workspace-list-users]



READ-ONLY



Returns users in a workspace, or all org users if no workspaceId given.

- workspaceId (opt): use workspace-list; omit for org-wide listing

- page (opt), pageSize (opt, default 200)

→

    {results: [{userId, email, name, roles, licenses, workspaceMemberships}]}

see: workspace-add/remove-users (manage membership), user-find-by-filter (advanced multi-field filtering)

[operation: workspace-add-users]



MUTATING — IDEMPOTENT



Adds users to a workspace. Already-members are silently skipped.

- workspaceId (req): use workspace-list

- userIds (req): non-empty list; use user-find

→

    {}

see: workspace-list (find workspaceId), user-find (resolve userIds), workspace-list-users (verify after)

[operation: workspace-remove-users]



MUTATING — IDEMPOTENT



Removes users from a workspace. Other workspace memberships unaffected. Team memberships NOT affected.

- workspaceId (req): use workspace-list

- userIds (req): non-empty list

→

    {}

⚠ may affect active distributions and routing rules within the workspace

see: workspace-list (find workspaceId), workspace-list-users (verify after), workspace-remove-users-all (all workspaces at once), team-remove-users (for team offboarding)
